headline: Much of what the parent-atlas-openspec-control-plane proposal asks to build already exists, live, under a different name and location than the proposal assumed. The proposal's own premise ('Parent Atlas SSR admin UI: Not yet proven end-to-end') is corrected by this census: it exists and is live at /atlas/studio/openspec.

owners.evidence: docs/reports/openspec-workboard-v1.json, schema atlas.openspec.workboard.v1, source: openspec/changes/*/tasks.md, summary.totalTasks: 9393 (live-read this run).

No typed TS contract exists for openspec-workboard-v1.json's own flat shape (schema, generatedAt, source, summary, ordering, indexing, lanes, workPackages, executionSteps, changes, taskInventory, nextTasks, actionableTasks, waitingTasks, supersededTasks, writes). A DIFFERENT, narrower typed contract (OpenSpecBoardSnapshotV1/OpenSpecBoardTaskV1 in openspec-board/types.ts) already exists but describes a DERIVED composite, not this file directly (see finding 1 below). OCP-01 is real work, scoped to the workboard's own shape.

Defined and live. Identity source is the board task's stableKey as emitted by the ACP tool openspec:workboard_recommend (ACPToolRegistry.ts:1566). A DIFFERENT, unrelated stableKey concept also exists in src/mcp/trace-mcp-server.ts for Neo4j graph nodes -- naming collision risk flagged, not the same identity, do not conflate.

LIVE, auth-gated (requireUser -> redirect to /login), SSR load function reading readOpenSpecBoardSnapshot() + readOpenSpecAwarenessSnapshot() + readParentAtlasCapabilityCensus(), computing topic clusters and top-changes server-side. Explicitly declares persistence: {authority: 'docs/reports JSON receipts', postgresRole: 'optional read-model history only', writesPerformed: false} -- this IS the architecture invariant the new proposal describes, already implemented. The proposal's premise that this is 'not yet proven end-to-end' is INCORRECT as stated; it is live.

findings.severity: material, resolved by inspection (not a true authority conflict)
findings.detail: docs/reports/openspec-workboard-v1.json (L0, 9393 tasks, built directly from tasks.md) and docs/reports/openspec-execution-controller-v1.json (L1, 9275 tasks, DERIVED -- its own 'source' field literally says 'docs/reports/openspec-workboard-v1.json', policy RECOMMENDATION_ONLY_NO_LEDGER_OR_RUNTIME_MUTATION) are NOT two competing authorities. The 118-task count gap is a FRESHNESS gap: the controller report is dated 2026-09-20, one day older than the current workboard (2026-09-21). openspec-board/report-reader.ts already has a freshness/staleness field (freshness.stale, 15-minute threshold) that exists precisely to surface this. The openspec-board composite snapshot (used by the live /atlas/studio/openspec page) is built from ~17 of these L1-derived reports (execution-controller, actionable-work, waiting-dependencies, deferred-discoveries, blocker-audit, directory-graph, file-kmeans, challenger-tournament, etc.), NOT read directly from openspec-workboard-v1.json. This is a legitimate, already-designed layered pipeline (workboard -> derived analysis reports -> composite reader -> SSR page), just under different names/locations than the new proposal assumed. Recommendation: regenerate the stale L1 reports (a scheduling/freshness task, not an architecture change) rather than building a parallel reader of openspec-workboard-v1.json.

/atlas/studio/openspec is a real, auth-gated, SSR-rendering admin page today, with topic clustering, awareness snapshot, capability census, and an explicit no-writes-performed contract. OCP-03/04 should EXTEND this route and the openspec-board/* module, not create a new /admin/parent-atlas/openspec route or a parallel sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/atlas/openspec/ directory.

findings.severity: material, pre-existing debt unrelated to this change
findings.detail: Two ContextManifestV1-shaped files and two PromptPlanV1-shaped files already coexist unreconciled. OCP-09/12 must not add a third of either without first resolving which is canonical -- flagged per this repo's Duplication Prevention / One Canonical Runtime Owner rule, not resolved here (out of scope for a census).

recommendation: Do not create sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/atlas/openspec/ as a new directory, and do not build a second SSR route. OCP-01 (typed contract) should describe openspec-workboard-v1.json's actual flat shape directly (new, real gap) and separately note its relationship to the existing openspec-board composite (extend, do not replace). OCP-02/03 (Postgres projection, SSR wiring) should extend openspec-board/* and /atlas/studio/openspec rather than duplicate them. This is a significant enough correction to the proposal's premise that it should go back to the operator before any OCP-01 code is written, rather than auto-continuing.
